Which statement explains the change in the gas jars after 3 hours?
A
Bromine has a greater density than air.
B
Bromine particles move from an area of high concentration to an area of low concentration.
C
Bromine particles move faster than the particles in air.
D
The particles in air are heavier than those in bromine.
